name: Thistleshrub Valley
summary: In Tanaris, strange beasts keep Tran'rek from entering Thistleshrub Valley. They hope to return once the creatures are cleared away.

sections.title: A Dangerous Valley
sections.body: South-west of Gadgetzan, Tran'rek warns that Thistleshrub Valley is a dangerous place. Strange beasts roam there, including gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers. With so many about, Tran'rek will not return.

sections.title: Thinning the Thistleshrubs
sections.body: Tran'rek asks you to clear out eight gnarled thistleshrubs and eight thistleshrub rootshapers. They also want a closer look at the cactus in the valley, so leave some of it in one piece.

faq.q: Who asks for help with Thistleshrub Valley?
faq.answer: Tran'rek, in Gadgetzan, asks for help.
Thistleshrub Valley lies south-west of Gadgetzan.
Clear out eight gnarled thistleshrubs and eight thistleshrub rootshapers.

faq.q: Why does Tran'rek want some of the cactus left in one piece?
faq.answer: Tran'rek wants a closer look at the cactus in the valley, so leave some of it in one piece.
